name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I've spent my career doing exactly what this role asks — owning the full sales cycle and closing B2B SaaS deals — and I've done it in monday.com's own category. At Accelo I ran full-cycle, quota-carrying sales of complex CRM and project-management software to mid-market and professional-services clients, which makes the work-collaboration space you sell into familiar ground for me. I'm also Denver-based and ready for the in-office team.

What I bring to a Mid-Market AE seat is consultative, multi-stakeholder selling end to end. I prospect and build relationships with key stakeholders, run discovery, connect product capabilities directly to customer ROI, and carry deals through negotiation and contracting. At Accelo I built C-suite relationships and navigated complex deals alongside implementation teams; as founder of Solenzo I generate my own pipeline through outbound and close it independently, acting as the escalation point for every commercial issue. I'm a self-starter who manages my own time, prioritizes ruthlessly, and is energized by a fast-moving, AI-forward product I genuinely find fun to demo.

monday.com's positioning — where AI doesn't just assist, it executes — is something I can speak to credibly, because I build agentic AI workflows myself and can translate that capability into real customer value on a sales call. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help grow your mid-market book. Thank you for your consideration.
